input.title: Don't You (Forget About Me) (Live from Abbey Road Studios, London)

rationale: Multiple sources confirm the November 2019 Spotify Singles pair: a cover of Simple Minds' 'Don't You (Forget About Me)' and 'She Plays Bass', recorded at Abbey Road Studios, London; Last.fm shows the exact two-track tracklist and version suffixes. | sources: https://www.last.fm/music/beabadoobee/Spotify+Singles, https://www.ukfestivalguides.com/artists/beabadoobee/
